verdict.rationale: OpenCode is fully open source and can be installed and run locally via a simple install script, and the `opencode serve` command exposes a headless HTTP/OpenAPI server enabling full self-hosted, remote-accessible deployments — corroborated by a community member who confirmed running 'opencode serve' as a self-hosted service accessible from anywhere with a working mobile WebUI. Missing for 10: dedicated self-hosting/deployment guide (Docker, infra sizing) and stronger security hardening guidance, since community evidence notes the server can be exploited by unauthenticated local processes when enabled.
